name: deploy
description: Publishes the site's static export to a hosting service with the workspace's own saved credentials. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: which host fits the person, where to get a token, preview before publishing, and what each failure means in plain words. Netlify first; more hosts move in here one at a time. Also deploys the Tovu server itself to fly.io through a GitHub Actions workflow, with no CLI installed anywhere: one machine only (SQLite), secrets never in fly.toml, and deploying ships code, not content.
author: Tovu
